summary: Cat Jam is a stealth model that OpenCode made free on 2026-10-13. OpenCode's Console docs list Cat Jam Free (model id cat-jam-free) with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time, on the https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions endpoint. No end date is stated. The announcement describes it as very fast and built for agentic coding. Per OpenCode's docs, its provider does not use your data for model training but retains it for 30 days for safety reasons, so avoid sensitive inputs. Cat Jam Free is not available in Angola, Belarus, Cambodia, China (including Hong Kong and Macau), Cuba, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Iran, Iraq, Laos, Libya, Nigeria, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Venezuela, or the Crimea, Donetsk, and Luhansk regions of Ukraine.
claim_steps: Check geographic eligibility first: Cat Jam Free excludes the countries and Ukrainian regions listed in the summary and current Console models docs, including China (Hong Kong/Macau), Russia, Iran and North Korea.
Sign in to OpenCode Console and copy your API key. The general Console setup also asks for billing details and credits.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select Cat Jam Free (opencode/cat-jam-free).
Or call https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions with model cat-jam-free. The free period is limited-time.

Review Console billing before funding: auto-reload defaults to $20 when the balance goes below $5 and can be changed or disabled. Free token pricing does not establish a model-specific no-deposit onboarding waiver.
